prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object approached, pick up; check properties; move to storage; drop. If not, approach or scan. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToObjectStorage    /> <Action ID = DropObject    /> <SubTree ID = ObjectProperties    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
		DO ObjectProperties
		DO MoveToObjectStorage
		DO DropObject
	END
